newsitem.title: USA: GE unit, Thomas to create procurement service.
newsitem.headline: GE unit, Thomas to create procurement service.

text.p: GE Information Services and Thomas Publishing Co. said Monday they created a joint venture to offer a World Wide Web-based procurement service for corporate purchasing agents.
The new company, to be called TPN Register, will begin operations in April with users of the two companies' existing information services.
TPN is intended to blend GE's delivery service and Thomas's content, including supplier and price information and descriptive line-item detail under 55,000 product headings.
Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.
